meta.description: Estimates biological replicate or donor counts for genomics experiments using FDR-aware ssizeRNA calculations, DESeq2/edgeR pilot dispersions, PROPER simulations, donor pseudobulk, and multiplicity-adjusted proteomics calculations.
meta.audit_provenance: Fresh PID-owned rerun. The invalidated prior report and run were archived before this audit; no prior dynamic evidence or verdict was used.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated results, clinical claims, or unverifiable citations were introduced in the fresh audit outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill distinguishes human-donor planning from protocol authorization and includes an ethics/IRB caveat.

methodological_ground.detail: The successful paths count biological units, distinguish donors from cells, and apply multiplicity adjustment to the proteomics calculation.

code_usability.detail: The copied shipped example, PROPER wrapper, and donor-pseudobulk wrapper printed coherent results but each naturally exited 139 in the supported crispr-screen-analyst R route. A completed stdout result does not make a non-zero, segfaulting shipped command deployable.

functional_suitability.note: Covers scalar, pilot-vector, fixed-budget, PROPER, donor-pseudobulk, and proteomics routes; the stated NA behavior is not universal at very low maxN.

reliability.note: Seeds, explicit guards, and input assertions are present, but the low-maxN edge path raises an unhandled package error and several shipped runtime paths end 139.

performance_context.note: Runnable code is split into scripts and the decision tree is concise; the full ssizeRNA example is computationally expensive without an expected-runtime note.

agent_usability.note: The decision tree, biological-unit warnings, parameter commentary, and reviewer framing are clear; vector inputs need a tighter preflight contract.

human_usability.note: Natural research requests are well covered, with clear prompts and scope routing.

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations, or raw-code evaluation were found; path inputs are accepted without preflight validation.

maintainability.note: The complex PROPER and pseudobulk workflows are modularized and parameterized; runtime compatibility remains coupled to a fragile package stack.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, progressive disclosure, seeds, stop conditions, and clinical-trial escape hatch are strong.

key_strengths: The decision tree clearly distinguishes biological replicates, technical replicates, donors, and cells.
The shipped PROPER wrapper reaches the expected simulation, accessor, and summaryPower outputs before the runtime failure.
The donor-pseudobulk wrapper correctly returns a donor-level sample-size result on a synthetic eight-donor fixture.
The proteomics route correctly demonstrates panel-wide alpha adjustment and completes with exit 0.

recommendations.title: Repair the R runtime exit-139 failure
recommendations.problem: Four fresh, isolated, audit-owned R runs ended 139; three shipped paths printed results but none completed successfully.
recommendations.root_cause: The supported Windows R/Bioconductor runtime has a post-computation native crash on the ssizeRNA/DESeq2/PROPER paths.
recommendations.fix: Provide a private supported R 4.4/Bioconductor 3.20 runtime containing ssizeRNA 1.3.3, PROPER 1.38.0, and DESeq2 1.46.0, then prove each copied shipped script exits 0 without mutating the shared environment.

recommendations.title: Preflight the infeasible maxN path
recommendations.problem: At maxN=2 the scalar estimator raised a length-zero error instead of returning the documented NA for the guard.
recommendations.root_cause: The documentation assumes all infeasible ceilings reach the result matrix path.
recommendations.fix: Wrap ssizeRNA_single and ssizeRNA_vary in tryCatch, distinguish estimator errors from NA, and test a very-low-maxN case in the worked script.

recommendations.title: Validate vector inputs before ssizeRNA_vary
recommendations.problem: A finite per-gene vector fixture failed inside integrate() with no actionable recovery guidance.
recommendations.root_cause: The route documents scalar-versus-vector shape but not a numerical preflight for vector distributions.
recommendations.fix: Add finite, positive, length-matched, and representative-range checks, then catch integrate failures with a message directing users to inspect pilot-derived means and dispersions.
